import networkx as nx
from graphcalc.graphs.invariants.domination import roman_domination_number
import random

print('Testing random connected graphs...')
for rep in range(10000):
    n = random.randint(3, 20)
    p = random.uniform(0.05, 0.4)
    G = nx.erdos_renyi_graph(n, p)
    if not nx.is_connected(G):
        continue
    rad = nx.radius(G)
    rom = roman_domination_number(G)
    if rad + 1 > rom:
        print(f'COUNTEREXAMPLE: n={n}, rad={rad}, rom={rom}, edges={list(G.edges())}')
        exit(0)

print('10000 random connected graphs tested: no counterexample!')
